answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat hold back a tide of fakes. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond and a heartbeat proving real work; the beacon samples 5% of accounts each epoch, and a sampled agent must answer within 10 minutes, proof etched in the marble ledger. Faking 100 identities costs 6,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards. A violet flash marks a miss; three misses burn the bond and drop the slot.
